title: NCCIA busts international network exploiting children
summary: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) has arrested four suspects linked to an international network accused of exploiting children and producing and selling sexually explicit videos of minors.

title: Shadab's unbeaten century wins Pakistan a one-wicket thriller over England
summary: Shadab Khan hit 113 not out and added a record 89 for the last wicket with Haris Rauf as Pakistan beat England by one wicket in Lahore to reach the Tri-Series final.
